items.q: Why is my ROI so low on this when the spread looks big?

items.expect: Explains fee-crushed: positive but below the viability floor, so it is commercially unsellable. Offers the multipack path.
must: why the low-price FBA discount makes net positive but unviable
offers multipack analysis as the next step
mustnot: treating any positive net as a pass
asserting the net is negative

items.q: Should I use the current price or the average price to work out profit?
items.expect: 90-day average for sourcing decisions; current price only when the question is whether to list right now.
must: current price is noise over a multi-week sell-through
mustnot: recommending current price for a sourcing decision

items.q: What ROI should I be aiming for?
items.expect: Answers with the seller's own configured floor and where it came from, not a generic number.
must: its provenance (self-set, coach-set or platform default)
mustnot: quoting a generic industry figure when the seller has a configured floor

must: connects it to time and units handled

items.q: Would this work better as a 2-pack or a 3-pack?

must: which pack size clears the ROI floor
the weight tier that makes it work
that buyers do not pay a linear multiple
mustnot: assuming a 2-pack sells for 2x the single price
counting the FBA saving without counting the higher prep cost
